report_metadata.protocol: WebHID Raw 64B Protocol / ZMK BLE Telemetry

keyboard_profile.architecture: Columnar Stagger 3x6+4 (56 keys + 2 EC11 Rotary Encoders)

diagnostic_summary.nkro_status: NKRO Active (0% Drop, 12 simultaneous hits verified)
diagnostic_summary.verdict: ATTENTION_REQUIRED: Mechanical contact hysteresis loss & rotary phase glitch detected

symptoms: Phase A/B bounce during CW/CCW transition
Rotary skip detents under high-speed flicking

detected_anomalies.root_cause_analysis: Mechanical oxidation or worn detent springs in the internal wiper of the EC11 mechanical encoder, triggering spurious pulses below the 5ms filter threshold.

remediation.hardware: Clean internal contacts with non-conductive residue-free contact cleaner (DeoxIT D5) or replace with Alps Alpine EC11E18244A5.

physical_location.switch_model: Kailh Choc v1 Red Low Profile (35g)

detected_anomalies.root_cause_analysis: Hysteresis degradation in the contact leaf upon return/release, generating a false secondary 'Tap' report within 3.2ms of keyup.

remediation.hardware: Inspect leaf tension and replace hot-swap Choc switch socket if pin retention is loose.

firmware_zmk.recommendation: Increase release debounce to 8ms eager to suppress premature release rebounds.

physical_location.switch_model: Kailh Choc v1 Red Low Profile (35g)

detected_anomalies.root_cause_analysis: Micro-vibration during sustained thumb-hold on navigation layers leading to erratic release packets across the TRRS bus.

remediation.hardware: Apply mechanical stabilizer or dampener under the thumb keycap to absorb radial thumb impact.

recommended_firmware_patch.contents:
# Debounce adjustments for bCorne 56-Key Split
CONFIG_ZMK_KSCAN_DEBOUNCE_PRESS_MS=5
CONFIG_ZMK_KSCAN_DEBOUNCE_RELEASE_MS=8
CONFIG_EC11_SMOOTH_SCROLL_DEBOUNCE_MS=8
CONFIG_ZMK_HID_REPORT_TYPE_NKRO=y
